title: Varianted Vanilla
description: Adds biome-specific variants for many Minecraft mobs
body:
![Title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9976be14078db412e7d314244df6fa13ae802651.png) ### Adding variants to mobs that need some attention!
--- **Varianted Vanilla** aims to improve the design of mobs. and add extra variants for different biome types! inspired heavily by the "Spring to Life" update.
Current Mobs in the Pack - Spider - Pillager - Witch - Fox - Goat - Piglin
⚠︎ This pack is in an early-state so it might and will be polished and updated in the near future ⚠︎
---

    


**This resource pack uses Custom Entity Models (CEM) to add new mob models.** *While originally an OptiFine feature, it is also compatible with Entity Model Features and Entity Texture Features (EMF & ETF) as an alternative.*
